lines.1: 「So that's the story. Tomorrow, I have a date with the Princess.」
lines.2: 「I got all fired up, but it worked out great.」
lines.3: 「Good. You're starting to act like the old you again.」
lines.4: 「If you're going to do it, give it your best.」
lines.5: 「Huh. That's unexpected. You're actually rooting for me?」
lines.6: 「If you can win the Princess, it'll be a Cinderella story in its own way.」
lines.7: 「It'd give me a ton of confidence. Maybe even I can aim for a real catch.」
lines.14: 「You really got the guts to be alone with the Princess, huh? Do ya?」
lines.15: Crab hooked a finger under my chin and tilted it up.
lines.19: 「Ow! What's your problem? Quit chopping me!」
lines.21: 「Forecast says clear skies. Perfect date weather.」
lines.22: 「Hmph! Enjoy your stupid dream and die, moron!」
lines.25: 「Lively in here. Well, I can overlook it on a weekend. Here, I brought tea.」
lines.27: 「Why do you look so happy, Subaru?」
lines.29: 「So that is why you have been working so hard at your studies and training these last few days.」
lines.31: 「But to seriously court THAT Princess... You are deliberately choosing the path of carnage.」
lines.32: 「Still, I do not dislike that kind of passion. As your big sister, I will help my little brother with his love life.」
lines.33: Otome thumped herself on the chest.
lines.36: 「What's wrong, kid? Don't be shy. Tell us.」
lines.39: 「You haven't even decided where to go?!」
lines.40: 「I was the one who forced this date through out of nowhere.」
lines.41: 「Choosing the place, huh? Your taste is already being tested.」
lines.42: 「The Princess is selfish. Pick the wrong place and she might just go home.」
lines.43: 「Watch what you wear, too. The first time I met an online friend, she turned around and left on the spot. Women...」
lines.45: 「This. My best outfit... or so I hope. Crab said if I wanted to look cool and elegant, this was the one.」
lines.46: 「Yeah, that should work. Crab may be stupid, but she's got a good eye for clothes.」
lines.47: 「Even allowing for the difference between the Princess's taste and mine, that should be perfectly adequate.」
lines.48: 「Then there's this cologne Subaru gave me a while back. What should I do with it?」
lines.49: 「If you don't wear it regularly, it won't smell natural on you.」
lines.50: 「Fifty milliliters costs over ten thousand yen. It's too precious to spray around all the time.」
lines.51: 「You do not need cologne. I dislike it when a scent is strong enough to irritate my nose.」
lines.52: 「I planned out your date. What do you think?」
lines.54: 2. Lower her emotional guard with a sweet romance movie.
lines.57: 「There's no way that would ever work on the Princess.」
lines.58: Subaru tore the paper to shreds.
lines.60: 「A classmate told me about a workshop where you can make soba noodles by hand.」
lines.61: 「Apparently, you get to eat the soba you make. It is wholesome and educational. What do you think?」
lines.62: As expected, her idea was a little different from an ordinary person's...
lines.63: And the way it still involved food was very Otome.
lines.64: I could not tell her that any soba she made would probably be too awful to eat.
lines.66: 「That doing it with you would be fun.」
lines.67: 「I see. Then perhaps I will take you there sometime.」
lines.68: 「Otome, 'making soba by hand' doesn't mean you actually get to behead anybody. That's not what 'by hand' means.」
lines.70: 「Ah! Being hit by a woman makes me angry--and scares me--so what is this thrill welling up inside me?」
lines.71: 「I'm starting to think we're never going to settle on a plan.」
